rule_text: Cyclists may cross the line on the bike path only toward the camera (from the far end of the path to the near end).

zones.description: the bike path around the line

lines.description: across the bike path; the camera stands at the near end, so riding toward the camera means moving down the image

notes: Pexels video 39026834 (Pexels License; not redistributed), the same Santos bike path from the other end; 640x360 preview, source t 3-23 s, 10 fps, metadata stripped. Fixed camera (0 px shift). Riders far up the path that never reach the line are not labelled.
